metadata.title: Sepia Country Portrait with Vertical Slab Serif

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, sepia-toned close-up portrait of a man in a cowboy hat, featuring a hand in the foreground with three fingers raised, creating a shallow depth of field. The only non-sepia element is the striking blue of the eyes, with bold vertical typography running down the right edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground hand partially obscuring the face to create depth
Monochromatic sepia palette contrasted by selective color in the irises
Vertical text alignment mirroring the verticality of the raised fingers
Wide-brimmed hat framing the top of the composition
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation on the right margin
Three-finger gesture in the immediate foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up; the face and hand occupy 80% of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The three raised fingers in the foreground and the blue eyes behind them.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the foreground fingers, moves up to the blue eyes, then follows the vertical text down the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the brim of the hat and the shoulders fill the corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia (brown/tan) for skin, hat, and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the typography and shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation sepia overall with high saturation in the small eye area.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Characters rotated 90 degrees clockwise to read vertically top-to-bottom
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all elements to maintain a rugged, consistent brand.
graphicDevices: Vertical rule or separator between name and numeral

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif and blunt terminals.
Provides the classic western/country aesthetic with strong serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned close-up of a man wearing a cowboy hat, with his hand in the foreground showing three fingers. The eyes must be a bright, saturated blue while the rest of the image is monochromatic tan/brown.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical text on the right side using a bold slab-serif font in black. Rotate the text 90 degrees clockwise so it reads from top to bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the image entirely sepia except for the eyes?
Is the text oriented vertically on the right side?
Are there three fingers clearly visible in the foreground?
Is the font a heavy slab-serif?

adjustableVariables: Number of fingers shown in gesture
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the foreground hand
avoid: Color bleeding from eyes to skin

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible and correctly rotated.
Check that the blue eyes do not look unnatural or glowing.
Verify the hand gesture is anatomically correct.
Confirm the sepia tone is consistent across the hat and skin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Sepia Portrait + Selective Blue Eyes + Right-Aligned Vertical Slab Serif
